m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Welcome back to Caravan, Wanderer. I hear dark tidings from the Sand Sea. Xerxes rallies his armies for war. We must be ready when he comes.
What news from Aggrobah? They will join us in fighting the Overlord? This is a tremendous relief.
Ah, but the Sultana says this is not enough? Then she is indeed wiser than was the King of Thieves. I agree with her assessment.
Yes, of course. Do as the Sultana suggests. An alliance with the House Qhats will be our best chance to withstand the Overlord's onslaught.
You will find the Agouti Rift south of here in the Caterwaul Canyons. The sands have settled and the way is clear. Winds be with you, Wanderer.
Oh, thank the stars. Master, I hope you'll forgive me. I think I made an itsy-bitsy boo-boo. Everyone's mad at me, even the House Djinni.
Tell your friends in Caravan that Aggrobah will stand with them against Xerxes. Then join Istar to negotiate with House Tabbi.
Swan, it seems you took back the Palace with minimal difficulty. I cannot express my gratitude for your part in all of this.
The Hoods and I were honored to do our part, and as you requested, we are further honored to serve as your security forces from now on.
Excellent! Wizard, Ozzy, you came here seeking assistance for Caravan in defending Mirage from the Overlord Xerxes. I have not forgotten.
I fear, however, that even with the combined might of Caravan and Aggrobah, we may be outmatched. We will need the help of the House Qhats.
The noble houses were the first rulers of Mirage, and they still retain great power. The Qhats' petty squabbling won't make this easy, however.
Oh oh oh... I know! I can handle negotiations! I can go through the House Djinni who serve each of the House Qhat Lords!
Hmm. It's fine to open negotiations that way, but the Wizard should be lead negotiator. In fact, Istar, treat the Wizard as your Master for now.
Oh ok! Smart thinking, as always... You're so wise, Master... I mean... Sultana. I think this will actually be quite enjoyable.
All right, my new Master. I'll go on to the Agouti Rift and open negotiations with Murdak, the Djinni to House Tabbi. I'll see you there.
If she's going, how about I sit the Qhat bit out? Allergies, you know... and with these dry sinuses, I'd rather just stay here with the Sultana.
I'd like that. Wizard, inform your friends in Caravan of our plans, and then join Istar in Caterwaul Canyons. My hopes go with you.
